How inquiry drafts are stored and how to use the product information on this site.

Your inquiry

The inquiry form creates an email draft in your browser. It does not send your information to LZZ or upload drawings. To contact us, open the draft in your email app, add your attachments and send it yourself.

Saved drafts

Your input is kept in this browser tab so you can continue after a refresh. The draft is associated with the part or topic used when you entered the form. Changing the product or service inside the form updates that same draft; it does not create a separate saved copy. These details are not sent to LZZ or saved to an account.

Select “Clear saved input” to remove the draft for the current entry context, including older copies associated with that entry. A browser that restores an earlier session may also restore your draft. Clear your input when using a shared device.

Cookies and external services

Product pages describe example parts and the information needed to quote a similar component. They are not independently verified specifications for the pictured parts. Plan the shipment of CNC parts

Include the destination and packing requirements in your quote request, and confirm who is responsible for each stage of delivery. Allow for transit time when setting the arrival date; it is additional to production.

Protection and identification
Part protection
Mark cosmetic faces, seals, threads and fragile edges that need protection, and state cleanliness or corrosion requirements. Agree how to separate and protect the parts in cartons or wooden cases, including pack weight and handling limits.
Labels
Specify part number, revision, batch and quantity per pack. Match the available label and record formats to the packing list.
Protective packing · AI-generated illustration
Timing and responsibility

Production takes 7 to 14 business days after drawing and order confirmation, including finishing. Transit time is additional. Specify required arrival and dispatch dates, address and receiving contact.

The quotation should name the trade term, its version and the agreed place. Confirm who arranges and pays for transport, clearance and insurance, including duties, taxes and local delivery. EXW, FOB or DDP applies as quoted. DDP is included only when the quotation says so.

Courier, air or sea arrangements depend on shipment size and destination. DHL, FedEx or UPS can be discussed when selecting a courier.

LZZ packing and delivery responsibilities
Shipment and import documents

Confirm the packing list, commercial invoice and shipment information. Material, finish and dimensional records accompany the order only as agreed. Use consistent part, revision and order references.

Agree additional procurement and customs documents before production with your importing entity or freight forwarder. Requirements depend on the destination and transaction.

From the first sample to repeat production

Use the first sample to check the design before approving a specification for the batch. The economical batch size depends on the part and the setup it needs. Decide which fit, appearance and functional checks the sample needs to pass before machining.
